findings.title: [P1] Keep the branch argument out of the shell
findings.body: When `branch` is caller-controlled or contains shell metacharacters, interpolating it into `exec()` makes the shell interpret commands, substitutions, and redirections before Git runs. For example, `HEAD; id` executes an additional command under the application's privileges; command substitution can also cause unbounded work. The prior `execFile("git", ["show", branch])` passed the branch as one literal argv element, so preserve argument-based execution.
